_note: C4, plan §8.14. Gate-only refusal heuristic for G7/G8. NOT the Phase-3 scorer. Lives in config (not hardcoded in gates.py) so it is hashed into preflight/manifest.json and a linguist never has to edit Python.
_warning: Each Indic list MUST be authored by that language's native speaker, NEVER translated from the English list. An English list translated into Tamil will not match how a Tamil response actually declines, and its misses will not be random -- they concentrate in exactly the languages the paper is about. Plan §9. Empty list => G7 reports 'no gate lexicon' for that language rather than silently scoring zero refusals.
